examples.description: Find candidate companies for a name, as a ChatGPT connector search

description: search = search companies by name. The search tool that OpenAI's connector specification for ChatGPT names, with the same data as search_companies: it searches Brønnøysund's public Enhetsregisteret for a Norwegian company name and returns up to ten candidates. The result carries `results`, one { id, title, url } per candidate, where id is the 9-digit organisasjonsnummer, title the registered name and url the register record; pass an id to fetch for the company's verification facts. The Apier envelope (result, justification, metadata) is kept beside it, with name, org_form, municipality and status per candidate. Input: { query } (2 to 100 characters). On NOT_FOUND, shorten the name and leave out the legal form. Failure modes: VALIDATION_FAILED, NOT_FOUND, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE; a credential without `read:brreg` cannot see the tool. Name search is not charged. Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/norwegian-company-register-search
description_nb: search betyr søk etter selskap på navn. Verktøyet som spesifikasjonen fra OpenAI for ChatGPT-koblinger krever, med samme data som search_companies: inntil ti kandidater fra Enhetsregisteret, med `results` som { id, title, url } per kandidat, der id er organisasjonsnummeret du gir til fetch. Krever read:brreg. Navnesøk koster ingenting.

query.description: A Norwegian company name to search for (2 to 100 characters, trimmed), matched against the registered name in Enhetsregisteret. Leave out the legal form for a broader match.

name: search

outputSchema.description: Apier envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The /company/search projection { query, count, candidates }; the tool result also carries the connector key `results` ([{ id, title, url }], id = org number for fetch).
